name: Install OAuth2 Proxy Hook
description: Deploys an on-start hook that runs oauth2-proxy in JWT-Bearer-only mode. Validates against Zitadel JWKS, proxies to the app's internal port, locks the app port via iptables. The hook lives in /etc/proxvex/on_start.d/ and runs on every container start (and once now via hook_trigger_now).

commands.description: Deploy oauth2-proxy on-start hook (runs at deploy + every container start)
